definitions.explanation: Forming an opinion or conclusion based on incomplete information or personal assumptions rather than evidence. Often carries a negative nuance, implying that the conclusion is unreliable.

examples.english: Don't say things based on speculation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な{憶測|おくそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{飛|と}び{交|か}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。

⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧せず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{憶測|おくそく}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ。
examples.english: It's dangerous to make judgments based solely on speculation without confirming the facts.

notes:
USAGE:
{憶測|おくそく} generally has a negative connotation, implying that the conclusion drawn is not well-founded. It is common in news commentary and formal discussions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {憶測|おくそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{飛|と}び{交|か}う (speculation flies around)
- {憶測|おくそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧ (to judge based on speculation)
- {憶測|おくそく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{過|す}ぎない→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧ (it's nothing more than speculation)
- {憶測|おくそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧ (to invite speculation)
- {憶測|おくそく}⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧ (speculative article)

WRITING:
Also written as {臆測|おくそく} with a different first character. Both writings are accepted and have the same meaning.
